description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class `NotYetPersistedException` used in the OpenMRS project, specifically within the custom datatype package. It indicates an error when attempting to access a value reference of a `SingleCustomValue` that hasn't been persisted yet.

classes.name: NotYetPersistedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a `SingleCustomValue` has not yet been persisted when its value reference is accessed.
